notes:
- Send to rekordbox keeps the whole playlist — importing over it no longer drops tracks, and it asks first if anything (a Tidal stream, say) can't come along
- Your rekordbox order survives the round trip with new tracks at the end — or pick Spotify's order beside Send
- Get a playlist's missing tracks in one sheet: matched on Beatport in seconds, with sleeves and previews, downloading as you go
- Unsure matches wait for you, every version on offer to hear and pick
- Fetches the extended mix, not the radio edit, and no longer re-downloads long versions you already own
- The board: build a night with Setline right inside Track Studio (after a one-time reinstall on Python 3.13)
